venture.name: Swyft
venture.business_concept: Photo-based AI clothing visualization and personalized fashion advice.
venture.primary_product_service: Proposed virtual try-on and styling experience for online clothing shopping.
venture.target_customers: Younger male and female consumers; shopping-oriented and convenience-seeking. Exact ages and income are unspecified.
venture.customer_need: Reduce uncertainty about how clothing looks and which styles suit the individual.
venture.value_proposition: Combine personalized clothing previews with fashion advice to make online shopping more convenient.
venture.geographic_market: Nationwide; United States is a research assumption, not specified in the venture document.
venture.distribution_channels: Online clothing-company feature is proposed; ownership, retailer partnerships and standalone app distribution are unspecified.
features: Personal details such as height, hair and eye color
venture.mission_statement: Our mission is to bridge the gap between digital and physical shopping through AI-powered experiences that bring clothing to life on the individual.
assumptions: US consumer market used to select storefront and currency.
Consumer-paid digital service used as a conditional pricing scenario; venture does not identify the payer.
Exact visual or physical fit accuracy is an aspiration and has not been validated.

pricing_comparison.comparison_name: Lowest listed paid annual consumer access per competitor
pricing_comparison.excluded_rule: Exclude free plans, other annual SKUs, monthly/weekly plans, guides, credits and unavailable web plans.
pricing_comparison.comparability_note: Annual comparison measures lowest listed paid annual access per brand, not equivalent try-on credits, accuracy or feature bundles. Basic Acloset entitlement and Style DNA SKU mapping are unconfirmed.

preliminary_pricing_recommendation.scenario: Consumer-paid Swyft service; conditional on confirming payer
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.free_tier: Test a limited preview allowance; determine quota from generation costs rather than inventing a credit count.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.rationale: Monthly range sits above Acloset Basic Monthly $3.99 and at or below the lowest Style DNA monthly listing $7.99. Annual range starts near the $29.99 entry annual listings for FitRoom and Style DNA, with a modest premium at its upper end. Combined previews and advice must justify that premium.
uncertainties: Costs, willingness to pay and repeat usage unknown
Try-on quality and retailer integration untested
Merchant payer scenario requires different benchmarks

market_opportunities.interpretation: Test a single flow that previews an uploaded garment and explains why it suits the shopper.
market_opportunities.evidence: FitRoom emphasizes visualization; Style DNA emphasizes personalization. Acloset already combines both, so this combination alone is not a unique advantage.

market_opportunities.interpretation: Differentiate through easy retailer item imports, dependable previews, clear photo deletion controls and transparent credit limits.
market_opportunities.evidence: These are product hypotheses; this study did not establish that competitors lack these capabilities.

research_limitations: Prices are observed listings on 2026-10-27, not purchased or authenticated checkout quotes; availability can vary by account, country, platform and time.
US and consumer-paid business model are assumptions. A retailer-funded Swyft feature needs a separate merchant research exercise.
App Store duplicate labels and different prices do not establish promotions, universal eligibility, renewal prices or identical feature access. Regular and promotional prices remain null.
Annual comparison measures lowest listed paid annual access per brand, not equivalent try-on credits, accuracy or feature bundles. Basic Acloset entitlement and Style DNA SKU mapping are unconfirmed.
Whering and other free tiers are excluded from paid statistics. Free download alone is not treated as free full service.
FitRoom web paid values are unreliable render placeholders. Standard and Pro prices remain null and are excluded.
No product tests, fit-accuracy tests, customer surveys, cost analysis, profitability analysis or exhaustive market census were performed.
One-time item billing and Acloset bean consumption are insufficiently specified for usage-normalized comparisons. Taxes, additional purchases and trial eligibility were not reliably established.
No competitor-specific youth targeting or exact age segmentation is claimed. No market share or return-reduction claim is established.

verification_definitions.Verified: Directly observed official page or authoritative primary storefront listing; scope is the listed fact.
verification_definitions.Partially Verified: Retailer or search evidence without complete primary confirmation.
verification_definitions.Estimated: Explicit analytical estimate rather than listed price.
verification_definitions.Unavailable: Reliable public price could not be established.
